en: He's stopped running off to play, it seems,
and he reads books all day long instead.
Books on politics and philosophy, at that.
Perhaps he means to follow in my footsteps
and become a politician.

He can't change overnight, so

and reigns of terror.

en: Make my son himself again!
You mean that worthless son of yours?

Before long, he'll make a far better
politician than you.
Don't be absurd!
As he is now, he'll never be a mayor like me,

Fool!

so how could you ever rule a whole town?!
I have no time to stand here talking
politics with you.

The matter... at hand?

This very night,
Calstatt becomes my town.

"Dhampir"...?
You bastard
not content with my son,
you'd put this town under your control too?!
Under my control?

Truly,
